verdict.rationale: The docs present the REST API, multi-language SDKs and CLI as peers of the Web UI for running parse jobs. All five core products (Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, Index) have documented APIs and are also exposed as tools through the hosted MCP endpoint. Webhooks and reusable saved configurations referenced by ID support fully programmatic workflows. Missing for 10: no explicit UI/API parity statement, no evidence that admin functions (SSO/RBAC, project and org management) are API-accessible, no published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and no independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
